title: Graphic Designer at Fella Health — (Remote, US Hours, $25k - $32k/yr total comp inc equity)
description:
About Fella Health

Fella Health helps middle-aged men live 10 years longer.

We are the telemedicine clinic for bigger guys, worldwide. We use medical weight loss treatment to solve our fellas' most pressing healthcare need, then remain a fella's core healthcare provider for the rest of their life - focused on men's health, longevity, mental health, and primary care.

We will have served 1 million fellas by the end of 2026, and 10 million fellas by the end of 2028.

Our mission is to solve male obesity worldwide, by accelerating the take-up of GLP-1s in middle-aged men. From this, we’ll become the world’s leading men’s health brand.

We’ve grown >150x since Sept 2022, grown >10x since Nov 2023, and are strongly cashflow positive . We have expanded our state coverage to >95% of US population, have started to expand our clinical protocol beyond weight (e.g. testosterone), and are eyeing up international expansion.

We're still a young startup and are moving quickly. We have a long way to go. This is still Day 1.

You can read more about working at Fella here:

We're backed by top healthcare & consumer investors:

  • Y Combinator

  • Global Founders Capital

  • AngelList Early Stage Fund

  • BrandProject

  • The founders of Indeed, Curative, Alan, Kaia Health, Vouch Insurance, Not Boring

The opportunity as Graphic Designer

Fella Health is building a world-class team.

As a Graphic Designer at Fella Health, you’ll work closely with our Creative Lead to deliver visually compelling and high-converting static ads for our DTC campaigns.

You'll start by analyzing all of our existing static ads to understand what has been performing well and reviewing all our design elements to explore how we can optimize and elevate our visual content performance.

Over time, you'll develop high-performing static ads to be displayed across various platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google, and more, continuously analyzing data, testing new ideas, and iterating on the designs to improve their performance and help us achieve our goal of serving 10 million fellas by the end of 2028.

This is a full-time remote role.

You'll report directly to our Creative Lead (André Andrade ), as well as work closely with our Media Buyer.

Key Responsibilities

Straight away:

Design and optimize visual content :

  • Take over the creation and finalization of static ads for various campaigns, ensuring high-quality outputs that align with brand standards and campaign goals.

  • Analyze the performance of visual content across different platforms, using metrics to assess engagement and ROI. Provide insights to inform future design strategies.

  • Conduct A/B tests on different graphic elements, styles, and other variables to identify what drives the best performance. Apply these learnings to optimize future designs.

  • Work closely with internal creative teams to ensure graphic content is aligned with overall campaign objectives and brand messaging. Provide feedback and guidance to improve visual output.

In the near future:

  • Innovate with new design trends and platforms : Stay ahead of design trends and experiment with new styles and platforms (e.g., social media, print, digital ads) to reach and engage with the target audience effectively. Be an early adopter of emerging design technologies and techniques.

Need to Have

  • DTC Designer Mastery: You have 4+ years of proven experience as a Graphic Designer, with a strong portfolio showcasing examples of static ads and proven experience as a Graphic Designer for a DTC brand.

  • Software proficiency: You are an expert at Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc). You have a strong understanding of typography, color theory, and layout design.

  • Data-driven optimization : You are great at analyzing static ads performance data, A/B testing and applying data-driven learnings to improve static ads.

  • Entrepreneurial drive : You’re creative, highly organized, and detail-oriented, a great communicator and are excited by the opportunity to build something new and impactful.

Nice to Have

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts or other related field.

  • Experience: You’ve previously worked in a DTC company in the healthcare industry.

Our cultural standards

These are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members at Fella:

  • Belief in the mission — we will have served 10 million fellas by the end of 2028 and we transform the life of most fellas who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our fellas and are dedicated to the mission.

  • Bulldozing barriers — the world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves.

  • Unwavering integrity — we are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  • Enduring frugality — we are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. We spend our cash wisely & carefully - in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  • Do what is needed — speed is critical and often the solutions we need are messy. We are comfortable moving quickly, taking on gritty work, and owning projects from noticing the problem to delivering the outcome.

  • Distaste for incompetence — we’re highly capable. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. We’re obsessed with our role, with a commitment to compounding self-improvement.

  • Commitment to candor — we believe in open communication and transparency. We are clear & caring communicators, welcoming feedback.

  • Only the paranoid survive — the road of expansion is bumpy. We are not fair weather sailers; we embrace the storms. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — all our work is still ahead of us.

  • Keep your head down — we’re boring people doing exciting work. We don’t chase short-term status: we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

“You just build a amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the fella. Give the fella massively more value than you take.” — a poetic extract from one of our advisors

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation : $25k - $32k/yr total comp (salary + equity)

  • Healthcare : comprehensive medical insurance

  • Vacation : PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays)

  • Remote : our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely

  • Personal development : budget for books, courses, coaching

  • Personal wellness : budget for gym, health apps

  • Coaching : free biweekly health coaching

title: Senior Software Engineer São Paulo
description:
Checkout.com is one of the most exciting fintechs in the world. Our mission is to enable businesses and their communities to thrive in the digital economy. We’re the strategic payments partner for some of the best known fast-moving brands globally such as Wise, The Hut Group, Sony Electronics, Sainsbury’s, Deliveroo, Adidas, Klarna and many others. Purpose-built with performance and scalability in mind, our flexible cloud-based payments platform helps global enterprises launch new products and create experiences customers love. And it's not just what we build that makes us different. It's how.

We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate and do their best work. That’s why we’re on the Forbes Cloud 100 list and a Great Place to Work accredited company. And we’re just getting started. We’re building diverse and inclusive teams around the world — because that’s how we create even better experiences for our merchants and our partners. And we need your help. Join us to build the digital economy of tomorrow.

Job Description

Global payments are complex and ever-evolving. At Checkout our software engineers develop the next-generation payments technologies that enable our Merchants to boost their acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting edge technology that enables extraordinary customer experiences.

We're looking for Senior Software engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature and are passionate about working in an Engineering environment which focuses on building products to achieve the company's strategic goals. You’ll get to work with teams from across Checkout.com’s portfolio of products and services who all have a real customer first philosophy.

As a Senior Software engineer, you will lead and drive specific projects critical to Checkout's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display exceptional leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Across the business we primarily use C# .Net Core, hosted on AWS with event-driven microservices, but we're happy to up-skill engineers from certain backgrounds like Java to adapt to our stack. With your technical expertise you will lead project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

How you’ll make an impact:

  1. Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community.
  2. Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a wider microservices using industry best practices.
  3. Stay up-to-date, use, and spread knowledge of the latest technologies used by Checkout.
  4. Write clean, maintainable, extendable and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems.
  5. Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.
  6. Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development.

Qualifications

What are we looking for:

  1. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  2. Proficiency in .NET C# with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full stack environment.
  3. Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
  4. Ability to speak English at a professional level.
  5. Experience working in agile environments and delivering high-quality code within tight deadlines.
  6. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  7. Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not a necessity.

Additional Information

Apply without meeting all requirements statement

If you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please apply anyway. We're always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

We believe in equal opportunities

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However you identify. And whichever payment method you use.

Our clients come from all over the world — and so do we. Hiring hard-working people and giving them a community to thrive in is critical to our success.

When you join our team, we’ll empower you to unlock your potential so you can do your best work. We’d love to hear how you think you could make a difference here with us.

We want to set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. We’ll be happy to support you.

title: Oficina capacita pessoas com deficiência para elaborar projetos culturais em MS
description:
Oficina capacita pessoas com deficiência para elaborar projetos culturais em MS

Com o intuito de capacitar pessoas com deficiência para a criação, estruturação e execução de projetos culturais inclusivos, a FCMS (Fundação de Cultura de Mato Grosso do Sul) e a Setesc (Secretaria de Estado de Turismo, Esporte e Cultura), em parceria com o programa Inclui MS, promoverá a “Oficina de Elaboração de Projetos Culturais para Pessoas com Deficiência” no dia 18 de novembro. As inscrições estão abertas (clique para acessar ) .

A iniciativa busca fomentar a participação ativa de pessoas com deficiência na cena cultural local, promovendo o uso da Libras (Língua Brasileira de Sinais) e audiodescrição como práticas padrão em eventos culturais. A oficina é destinada a pessoas com deficiência, incluindo artistas, produtores culturais e gestores de espaços culturais, que desejam contribuir para o fortalecimento do cenário cultural inclusivo.

A atividade contará com 30 vagas limitadas, será gratuita e acontecerá no MIS (Museu da Imagem e do Som), localizado no 3º andar do Memorial da Cultura “Apolônio de Carvalho”, em Campo Grande, das 19h às 21h, com acessibilidade em Libras e audiodescrição.

A capacitação visa ampliar o acesso e a participação de pessoas com deficiência no cenário cultural de Mato Grosso do Sul. Em consonância com a Lei Aldir Blanc, que destina 5% dos recursos para ações afirmativas voltadas a esse público, a oficina procura democratizar o acesso à produção e fruição artística, abrangendo tanto áreas urbanas quanto rurais e periféricas. A capacitação surge em resposta às dificuldades enfrentadas por muitos produtores e artistas com deficiência, que encontram obstáculos para elaborar projetos devido à falta de informação e acessibilidade.

Serviço

Horário: 19h às 21h
Local: MIS – Memorial da Cultura “Apolônio de Carvalho” – Av. Fernando Corrêa da Costa, 559, 3º andar – Centro, Campo Grande (MS)

Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores, pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 31 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo, somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora.

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

As áreas estão divididas entre os editais:

  • Edital nº 14/2024: Computação / Automação Industrial (1 vaga); Computação / Redes de Computadores (1 vaga); Educação Matemática (1 vaga); Estatística (1 vaga); Física/Ensino de Física/Física e Ensino de Física para comunidades tradicionais (1 vaga); Computação/Sistemas Distribuídos (1 vaga); Direito Privado (1 vaga); Direito Público (1 vaga); Engenharia Mecânica/ Materiais e Processos de Fabricação (1 vaga); Engenharia Mecânica/ Ciências Térmicas (1 vaga); Engenharia Mecânica/ Mecânica dos Sólidos (1 vaga); Engenharia Civil / Geotecnia (1 vaga); Engenharia Civil / Hidrotecnia (1 vaga); Engenharia de Produção (1 vaga); Engenharia da Qualidade e do Trabalho (1 vaga); Sistema de Recirculação para Aquicultura (1 vaga); Aquicultura (1 vaga); Animais Aquáticos Cultiváveis (1 vaga); Topografia e Geodésia (1 vaga); Geologia/Recursos Hídricos/Paleontologia (1 vaga); Pesquisa em Psicologia e Formação de Psicólogo (1 vaga); Ginecologia e Obstetrícia (1 vaga); Medicina Legal e Perícia Médica (1 vaga); Nefrologia (1 vaga); Estágios supervisionados (1 vaga); Pediatria (1 vaga); Radiologia e/ou diagnóstico por imagem (1 vaga); Clínica Médica: Reumatologia e Imunologia clínica (1 vaga); Medicina da Família e Comunidade (1 vaga);

A remuneração varia de R$ 2.437,59 a R$ 10.481,64 e as jornadas de 20 a 40 horas semanais ou dedicação exclusiva, com acréscimo de auxílio-alimentação.

As inscrições seguem até o dia 16 de dezembro via site do UFGD, com a taxa de inscrição no valor de R$ 200,00.

Os candidatos serão avaliados por prova escrita, prova didática e análise de títulos. A prova escrita está prevista para ser realizada no dia 9 de março.

A Universidade Federal da Grande Dourados (UFGD) está também com um concurso público para preencher uma vaga exclusiva para indígenas das etnias Guarani ou Kaiowá.

O cargo é para a carreira de magistério superior, com lotação na Faculdade Intercultural Indígena (FAIND), na área de Ensino Intercultural em Ciências Humanas.

Entre os requisitos está ser falante das línguas Guarani ou Kaiowá, possuir licenciatura plena em qualquer área e ter mestrado em Educação e Territorialidade, Antropologia, História, Geografia ou Sociologia.

A remuneração para o cargo varia de R$ 3.046,99 a R$ 7.312,77, conforme a carga horária, além de um auxílio-alimentação de R$ 1.000 para jornadas de 40 horas semanais.

As inscrições seguem até o dia 16 de dezembro por meio do site da própria UFGD. A taxa de participação é de R$ 200,00.

A seleção inclui prova escrita, que será aplicada em 9 de março, prova didática e o procedimento de heteroidentificação nos dias 15 e 16 de março, e o cadastramento dos títulos será de 25 a 27 de março.

Após essas etapas avaliativas, a divulgação do resultado preliminar será feita em 7 de abril e, após o período de recursos, o resultado final será publicado em 9 de abril.

Acteur majeur de l'innovation, Bertin Technologies vous propose de prendre part à une aventure technologique initiée en 1956. Vous y exprimerez vos compétences et votre personnalité au sein d'une structure souple, dynamique et ambitieuse qui valorise l’humain et l’associe à la réussite de la société. Pour nous aider à atteindre nos objectifs de performance, notre ambition se poursuit et nous renforçons nos équipes alors rejoignez-nous et devenez notre nouveau Technicien d’Intervention sur site (H/F) !

title: Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine
description:
Career Opportunities with Community Health Centers of the Central Coast

A great place to work.

Careers At Community Health Centers of the Central Coast

Share with friends or Subscribe!

Are you ready for new challenges and new opportunities?

Join our team!

Current job opportunities are posted here as they become available.

Subscribe to our RSS feeds to receive instant updates as new positions become available.

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine

Wage Range that the Company Expects to Pay: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly

SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results the Physician provides primary healthcare services for Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC), and to perform related work as required.

It is the primary purpose of CHC to provide the highest quality of total care possible to the patient population it serves. Such a level of quality depends ultimately on the staffs desire and ability to work together, individually, and as a team. The employee is expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic at all times.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Duties assigned by the Chief Medical Officer include, but are not limited to, the following activities and may be adjusted based on patient and clinic medical service requirements:

Secures and evaluates a patient's health history and records findings in a systematic, accurate and succinct manner.

Performs a physical assessment and is able to discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.

Provides routine physical examinations, diagnostic services and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.

Adheres to the highest standards of medical ethics at all times.

Assures quality of care for all patients.

Shares on-call duties, when indicated, with other members of the medical staff.

Elicits and records information about patient's medical history.

Examines patient to determine general physical condition.

Orders or executes various tests, analyses, and diagnostic images to provide information on patient's condition.

Analyzes reports and findings of tests and of examination, and diagnoses condition.

Administers or prescribes treatments and drugs.

Inoculates and vaccinates patients to immunize patients from communicable diseases.

Advises patients concerning diet, hygiene, and methods for prevention of disease.

Reports births, deaths, and outbreak of contagious diseases to governmental authorities.

Refers patients to medical specialist or other practitioner for specialized treatment.

Conducts physical examinations to provide information needed for admission to school, consideration for jobs, or eligibility for insurance coverage.

Assists the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies, evaluating existing policies and developing changes in policies as necessary; designing, implementing, and evaluating education programs for patients and staff.

Shares supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required.

Works within privileges and protocols as established by the Chief Medical Officer.

Participates in committees as requested by the Chief Medical Officer.

Demonstrates adherence to and observes all safety policies and procedures, inclusive of infection control rules and regulations.

Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served (infants, pediatrics, adolescent, adults or geriatrics).

Demonstrates knowledge of domestic violence, child, and dependent and elder abuse protocols.

Maintains and adheres to HIPAA, confidential and privileged communications (patient, employees, and corporation).

Participates in patient population management as it relates to clinical services while taking into account cultural diversity and local resources.

Participates in the team member's care coordination by providing follow up phone calls post hospital discharge, Assists the patient with follow up appointments within the recommended time frames and gather data from recent hospital admissions to facilitate follow up.

Understands the role in self-management support by developing a relationship with high risk clients and anticipate what needs they may encounter. Develop the ability to refer to an RN when clinical judgment is in question.

Develop communication skills with all members of the team both internal and external, by first being a patient advocate and use the available resources to facilitate care. Coordinate with the Care Team (PCP, RN, Health Educator, LCSW, Director of Nursing and/or Chief Medical Officer) to ensure appropriate services are arranged for the patient in order for them to meet their goals.

Understand the role in the quality improvement process which may include meetings, data collection and charge auditing. Use Evidence Based Practice guidelines to assist with disease management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Medical Doctor Degree (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school. Completion of a residency training program in the field Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics, required. Board Certified or board eligibility required. Maintains current knowledge in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics through continuing medical education, participation in local and national medical societies.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret the most complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries or complaints. Bilingual (English and Spanish) ability to speak, read, write Spanish desirable.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to interpret bar graphs.

REASONING ABILITY

Authoritative knowledge of the principles, practice and techniques of family-centered medicine. Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Possession of current unrestricted and valid License - Physician and Surgeon or equivalent from Medical Board of California. Board Certified/Eligible Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics, required. Possession of current unrestricted and valid DEA license, Advanced Cardio Life Support (ACLS) for FP/IM, Pediatric

Advanced Life Support (PALS) card for PEDS; and Basic Life Support (BLS-C) card for all specialties.

Annual health examination; annual TB skin test clearance or biannual chest x-ray, and up to date immunizations for health care workers at time of hire and annually thereafter.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Must be willing to have a flexible work schedule that may include late evenings and weekends, and be able to travel to other clinic sites or locations as needed.

  • The versatile and adaptable skills necessary to flourish in a fast-paced and wide-ranging work environment, working across time zones using tools such as Zoom, Slack, and email (Google Workspace).

Boa comunicação oral e escrita em português.

title: Procurement Analyst
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Operations at TRACTIAN

The operations team is responsible for turning our IoT devices into reality. We strive to make the impossible possible and are deeply goal-oriented. We integrate hardware, production, quality, and supply and we're in charge of the whole manufacturing process of our hardware, from the purchase of components to the final adapting of our devices to meet strict international criteria.

What you'll do

As a Procurement Analyst at Tractian, you'll be responsible for efficiently executing purchasing activities as part of the Supply Chain team. Your responsibilities will range from creating purchase orders to negotiating with local suppliers, ensuring alignment with requesting areas, and monitoring supplier performance. Additionally, you'll focus on ensuring product and service compliance while optimizing the speed of execution and delivery of these items.

Responsibilities

  • Develop new suppliers, including negotiating products and services.
  • Execute routine purchases, input orders into the SAP system, and monitor the delivery of negotiated items.
  • Serve as the interface between suppliers and internal requesting areas.
  • Ensure shared suppliers are effectively managed.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs to track supplier performance, continuously driving improvements in cost, lead times, and quality.
  • Identify and escalate issues that may impact Operations.

Requirements

  • Experience with procurement processes and supporting tools, including tax knowledge, negotiation skills, and the sourcing process.
  • Experience in negotiating supplier contracts.
  • Experience in ensuring compliance with procurement.
  • Practical experience related to the indirect material category.
  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Procurement, or Engineering.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with ERP SAP B1 or similar.
  • Experience with negotiating Marketing and Facilities items.
  • Advanced English.

Compensation:

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

title: Senior Data Analyst, Strategy Analytics
description:
Manychat is a leading Chat Marketing platform. We help businesses engage with their customers on Instagram, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

Manychat is a Meta Official Business Partner, backed by top investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners.

With 200+ teammates across three global offices — Barcelona, Yerevan, New York, Austin, and Amsterdam — Manychat helps more than one million businesses worldwide interact with billions of customers in real-time at scale.

No matter the use case — generating leads, increasing engagement, providing 24/7 customer support, accepting payments, and beyond — Manychat helps businesses improve their ROI and grow faster.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a passionate Senior Business Analyst to manage and lead company-level analytics initiatives in Brazil.

The Senior Business Analyst will join the analytics team and report to the Head of Analytics, with a dotted line to the Brazil General Manager. The new team member will directly impact the direction of Manychat's further growth in Brazil by helping to form the mid and long-term country roadmap.

The ideal candidate is capable of conducting quantitative research, generating and validating product and market hypotheses, bringing relevant insights, and proposing solutions to proactively drive the market towards achieving our business goals.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Our analytics team has three foundational purposes:

  • Impact directly on business metrics.
  • Be proactive.

As part of the analytics team, you will:

  • Investigate the product from different angles, consolidating insights into a clear and cohesive action plan.
  • Manage and lead Monetization initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain Manychat's operational/growth model.
  • Build tools to monitor the company’s performance and help make quick and effective data-driven decisions.
  • Manage data and analytics projects with external parties (segmentation, forecasting, and data labeling) to find and validate promising product hypotheses.
  • Collaborate closely with the Leadership Team to identify and resolve product and business growth bottlenecks.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of proven product/data/business analytics experience.
  • Technical background and knowledge of mathematical statistics.
  • Excellent technical skills (SQL, Python, BI tools).
  • Extreme attention to detail and strong work ethic.
  • Accountability and the permanent ‘extra mile’ approach to any task.
  • Readiness to take responsibility and obtain high-quality analytical deliverables in reasonable terms.
  • High level of proficiency in written and spoken English. (To be considered for this position, you must submit your resume in English)

Nice to haves:

  • Consulting (Big-4) background.
  • Previous experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

WHAT WE OFFER

We care about your growth, well-being, and comfort

  • Professional development budget for relevant conference tickets, training programs, or courses.
  • Flexible benefits plan to choose the perks that fit your needs.
  • Generous time-off policy to balance your work and life.

We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. description:
Do you want to contribute to the development of new tomato varieties? Are you passionate about plant breeding? Then you are the Breeder Tomato we are looking for to strengthen our breeding team in Almeria, Spain!

  • Location: Spain, Almeria
  • Department: Research & Breeding
  • Education: Master

Breeder Tomato

The Tomato breeding department of Rijk Zwaan Ibérica develops tomato varieties for many different market segments worldwide. As a Breeder Tomato, based in Spain, you will be part of our Tomato breeding team developing varieties for the winter protected cultivation market segment. As Breeder Tomato you will be working on new varieties, plant concepts, and disease resistances, in close contact with the market they are intended for and in close cooperation with the sales team. You work alternatively in the greenhouse and the office. In addition, you are involved in:

  1. Various breeding tasks such as phenotyping, evaluation, and administration of various selection and variety trials, both on location as abroad.
  2. International travel to judge variety trials.
  3. Setting up variety trials with different stakeholders like customers or research institutes.
  4. Taking part in strategic discussions about the breeding program.

What is your added value?

You are a real team player. You are proactive, creative, flexible, and solution-oriented. You like to take initiative. You have an eye for detail and are practical and pragmatic. You work in a structured manner and have excellent communication, organizational, and administrative skills. Mastering the English language is a prerequisite. Next to this we can find the following on your CV:

  1. A finished education on BSc or MSc level in the field of horticulture, agriculture, applied biology, or plant breeding.
  2. Experience of at least 5 years in plant breeding.
  3. Good command of English and Spanish language.

What can you expect from us?

As Breeder, you will be part of the Tomato department. Rijk Zwaan offers the opportunity to initiate and execute research that affects the world food supply. In addition to an ever-expanding international working environment, we are pleased to offer you:

  • A permanent contract right from the start.
  • A good salary based on job level and experience.
  • Various training opportunities through our Rijk Zwaan Academy.
  • An innovative working environment with continuous new challenges.

You can address your application. We will consider your application carefully, which may take some time. You will hear from us as soon as possible.

Nossos Shoppers são as pessoas mais importantes da nossa operação, pois são eles quem levam para os clientes toda a experiência que é comprar na Daki.   6. Assistência odontológica.

Sobre a Daki:

Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.

E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!

Aí criamos a Daki. :) Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.

Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:

Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas. Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.

Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!

Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.

Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.

Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.

E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.

Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar. Seja bem-vinda(o) à nossa página de Carreiras!

COMPANY OVERVIEW:
Balchem Corporation develops, manufactures, and markets specialty ingredients that improve and enhance the health and well-being of life on the planet. Our corporate headquarters is located in Montvale, New Jersey, and we have a broad network of sales offices, manufacturing sites, and R&D centers. Founded in 1967, Balchem is a publicly traded company (NASDAQ – “BCPC”) with annual revenues over $900 million and a market cap exceeding $4.0 billion.

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a full-time consultant based out of Brazil to help us grow our nutrients business in Brazil/Mercosur.

This role offers excellent growth potential both for the business and for the individual who can deliver results in a complex, rapidly changing work environment. The person in this position will manage, develop, and lead sales and market development efforts for his/her assigned territory. He/she will lead development and implementation of sales strategy in assigned territory to capture opportunities at key accounts Pharma and identify key segments for growth and is expected to achieve sales goals and budget targets.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. Foster and create customer loyalty through high professional conduct and practices that focus on and are consistent with Balchem core values.
  2. Develop strong and compelling sales strategies and execution plans for assigned territory on existing and new Minerals & Nutrients products.
  3. Develop, implement and manage plans and systems to nurture and grow sales with existing customers and target, develop and convert new customers.
  4. Maintain sales volume, product mix, and selling price by keeping current with supply and demand, changing trends, economic indicators, and competitors.
  5. Sales territory being Brazil and other Mercosur countries such as Argentina, Chile, Uruguay & Paraguay specially to Pharma accounts for sales of VitaCholine in human nutrition, microencapsulated nutrients (Vitashure), Albion Minerals, K2Vital and OptiMSM.
  6. Monitor & report competitors as far as pricing, capacity and lead times with focus on local manufacturers.
  7. Keep constant follow up of local regulatory scenario reporting any possible change that could affect Balchem business within the region.
  8. Develop strong technical knowledge of products offered for sale, including therapeutic benefits and applications.
  9. Monitor and report on activities and provide relevant information to management, including sales call reports and monthly work progress reports.
  10. Establish and maintain membership in appropriate trade associations, such as ABIAD, Abifisa and Sindusfarma.
  11. Follow and enforce all safety policies and procedures including use of company safety equipment (PPE) and equipment safeguards.
  12. Other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. Excellent sales and negotiating skills, technical, communication, presentation, energetic, motivated, personable, multi-task, oriented, growth oriented.
  2. Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  3. Undergraduate degree in a business or technical discipline; MBA or other post-graduate degree is preferable.
  4. At least five years professional sales experience in the food & beverage, human nutrition or pharmaceutical industry in LATAM.
  5. Strong network in Pharma, Food & Beverage and Dietary Supplement industry.
  6. Excellent cross-functional and interpersonal skills; able to effectively interact and collaborate with all levels of complex organizations.
  7. Strong leadership, motivational and presentation skills; effective planning, organization and time management skills; strong attention to detail and follow-up.
  8. Works successfully both independently and within team settings.

Balchem is committed to a workplace culture that values and promotes diversity, inclusion, equal employment opportunities, and a work environment free of harassment and hostility.

title: Técnico(a) de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho Sênior
description:
Técnico(a) de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho Sênior

Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma das líderes em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo norueguês produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Se você é Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho e possui sólido conhecimento técnico/normativo e experiência com ativos de energias renováveis, você poderá iniciar uma carreira que contribuirá para minimizar os efeitos climáticos, junto com a Statkraft.

Sendo responsável por garantir o atendimento aos requisitos de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e segurança patrimonial nas usinas da regional, através de inspeções, acompanhamento de atividades, treinamentos e suporte durante a realização de atividades de operação, manutenção e projetos de engenharia. Cumprir com as normas, política de negócios da Statkraft e a legislação vigente, preservando o meio ambiente, a segurança e o desenvolvimento sustentável dentro da área de influência da empresa.

Como Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho, você irá:

  • Acompanhar e dar suporte de saúde e segurança nas atividades de operação e manutenção em usinas de geração de energia renovável, principalmente em atividades de alto risco como Manutenções Gerais, projetos e atividades não programadas;
  • Acompanhar e fiscalizar as atividades dos prestadores de serviços e seus contratados;
  • Realizar e/ou dar suporte no processo de contratação de treinamentos de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente para a equipe das usinas da regional;
  • Realizar os treinamentos de segurança;
  • Elaborar e/ou revisar especificações técnicas para projetos de melhorias de saúde e segurança e analisar tecnicamente as propostas encaminhadas para contratação de serviços de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Realizar e/ou dar suporte na investigação de acidentes e incidentes com foco na determinação de análise de causa da raiz;
  • Acompanhar em campo as visitas de rotina de órgãos reguladores e demais entidades de fiscalização de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Revisar e/ou implantar procedimentos e programas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente aplicáveis às usinas;
  • Revisar o Perfil Profissiográfico Previdenciário (PPP) dos funcionários e ex-funcionários das usinas da regional;

The Account Manager at Massive Rocket is a dynamic, results-driven role focused on proactively generating new business opportunities. As the primary 'hunter' on our sales team, you’ll drive Massive Rocket’s growth by identifying and closing new clients, bringing our services to an expanded market.   1. Initial Client Relationships: build a strong foundation with clients, establishing Massive Rocket as a trusted partner from the outset.
  2. Collaboration with Delivery Team: support the delivery team to align projects with client needs and ensure proper resourcing for profitability.

Client Growth

  1. Identifying Growth Opportunities: work alongside the Client Partner to identify potential areas for additional business in new accounts.

Customer Relationship Development

  1. Relationship Standards: set and maintain the standard of excellence in client experience to build lasting partnerships from the start.

  1. 5+ years in a sales-focused, client-facing role, ideally in tech or digital marketing sectors.

  • CRM and Customer Engagement Strategy
  • MarTech – CDP, CEP, Marketing Cloud
  • Customer Data Management
  • Data Analytics and Reporting

Key Skills

  1. Proven Sales Acumen : Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets, with experience in consultative selling.

  3. Organisational Skills : Strong project management skills, with a proactive approach to managing the transition from sales to delivery.
  4. Communication : Strong verbal and written communication skills, capable of delivering clear and persuasive pitches.

title: Waynes Warbler Lead Technician
description:
The Center for Conservation Biology (CCB) is a research and education organization at William & Mary and Virginia Commonwealth University dedicated to bird conservation. The CCB’s mission, through all of its diverse programs, is to provide the global community with the information needed to drive thoughtful, science-based conservation, educate and train the next generation of conservation scientists, and make lasting contributions to the natural world through critical thinking, innovation, and ground-breaking research.

Position Summary

The Center for Conservation Biology is seeking a Crew Lead to conduct Wayne’s black-throated green warbler surveys, nest searching and monitoring, and lead a crew of 2-3 technicians in southeast Virginia from March 03-June 30, 2025.

Wayne’s warbler is a genetically unique form of black-throated green warbler (S. virens virens) that occurs in a disjunct breeding range along coastal swamps in the mid-Atlantic region. This project provides an opportunity to better understand Wayne’s warbler range and abundance in Virginia as well as describing nests and other demographic information that is not well documented.

The field site for the project will be areas surrounding the Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge (GDSNWR). Surveys will occur from the road and by boat, but the candidate will venture into swampy habitats when nest searching, monitoring, and attempting to capture birds. Housing will be provided at USFWS bunkhouse at the GDSNWR and private housing near Chesapeake Virginia. Pay is 18.00/hour (~$2,688/month).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience identifying eastern songbirds by sight and sound.
  • Ability to navigate using GPS and use a standardized survey protocol.
  • Experience with mist netting and/or banding.
  • Physically capable of accomplishing the work and willing to work early mornings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a field crew.
  • Experience operating a chainsaw.
  • Experience with canoes, kayaks, or motorized boats.
  • Experience with mist nets and bird banding.

Conditions of Employment

  • This position requires driving or riding in cars and boats to field sites.
  • The ability to work outdoors daily, and at times, under rigorous conditions.
  • The ability to perform physically strenuous duties and lift/carry 50 pounds.
  • A valid driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.
  • This is a non-exempt position, eligible for overtime.

William & Mary values diversity and invites applications from underrepresented groups who will enrich the research, teaching, and service missions of the university.

title: Head of Dry Cargo, Brazil
description:
BSc in Business Administration and International Business, MBA in Finance.

Position at NORDEN:

Head of Dry Cargo, Brazil

How long have you been with NORDEN?

I started inJanuary 2013.

Crossfit is my favourite sport in the world, and I usually like to start my day off with it to get ready for work. In my spare time, I like to travel to my hometown to visit my parents and brothers. They have a small brewery, and we brew beer together. My favourite is the stout beer with bacon flavour - it is a family special!

What is your background?

I started as a trainee in Gerdau, a steel mill company located in the countryside of Brazil. I was in charge of shipping, mainly working on shipments of coal to USA, Australia and Canada. Then, I worked as a broker in Maersk Broker and moved to London and Buenos Aires where my focus area was ECSA. Later, I moved back to Brazil to join NORDEN as assistant chartering manager.

What does your typical workday look like?

Today, we are more connected through cell phones and apps. So, my day usually starts off by checking my pop-up messages and talking with my colleagues in Copenhagen, who are 4-5 hours ahead from us depending on the time of the year. I work out at 6:30 a.m. every day and get in at the office at 9 a.m. where I spend most of my day talking with colleagues, brokers and clients. Chartering is a very dynamic job that requires us to be on top of the market in order to make the right decisions. The interesting thing is that each day is different!

What is the best part of your job?

The personal contact we have with our clients and brokers. To understand their needs and particularities are very interesting and important as NORDEN is involved in almost all types of commodities in dry cargo. In addition, NORDEN has employees of many nationalities, resulting in a very rich working environment.

Why did you choose NORDEN?

NORDEN is a well-established company with a solid background which allows the employee to have his/her own voice. The company supports growth, and most heads of P&L'sand overseas offices have been insourced. NORDEN is also a company ahead of its time because they recognise and reward talent and performance and supports more women in shipping.

title: Seduc-SP abre inscrições para contratação de professores na categoria O
description:
Seduc-SP abre inscrições para contratação de professores na categoria O

A Coordenadoria de Gestão de Recursos Humanos da Secretaria da Educação do Estado de São Paulo (Seduc-SP) anunciou a abertura das inscrições para docentes classificados no processo seletivo simplificado da Vunesp, realizado em 5 de junho de 2024, que se destina à atribuição inicial de classes e aulas para o ano letivo de 2025, conforme a legislação vigente.

NORMAS PARA CONTRATAÇÃO TEMPORÁRIA

O processo seletivo segue as normas estabelecidas pela Lei Complementar n º 1.093, de 16 de julho de 2009, que regulamenta a contratação por tempo determinado, conforme o inciso X do artigo 115 da Constituição Estadual.

As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pela plataforma Secretaria Escolar Digital (SED), disponível no site: sed.educacao.sp.gov.br, seguindo o cronograma abaixo:

  1. 21/11 a 01/12/2024 – Período de inscrição
  2. 21/11 a 26/11/2024 – Interposição de recursos
  3. 21/11 a 27/11/2024 – Análise de recursos pela Unidade Escolar
  4. 21/11 a 28/11/2024 – Análise de recursos pela Diretoria de Ensino
  5. 6/12/2024 – Divulgação da classificação final

Atenção: recursos só podem ser apresentados antes da confirmação da inscrição, acompanhados de justificativas e documentos comprobatórios. Recursos enviados após a confirmação não serão aceitos.

Durante o processo de inscrição, os professores deverão:

  • Confirmar seus dados pessoais;
  • Informar tempo de experiência no magistério;
  • Declarar raça/cor e, se aplicável, condição de pessoa com deficiência (PCD);
  • Atualizar ou confirmar sua formação acadêmica;
  • Indicar interesse no Itinerário Formativo Técnico Profissional;
  • Sinalizar interesse em participar de Programas ou Projetos da Secretaria;
  • Optar pela carga horária desejada;
  • Declarar interesse em atuar no Programa Ensino Integral (PEI);

Os docentes que desejarem se credenciar no PEI devem cumprir os seguintes requisitos:

  • Frequência mínima de 90% entre 15 de fevereiro e 31 de agosto de 2024;
  • Não ter acumulado 60 ou mais faltas-aulas no período mencionado.

A ausência de inscrição dentro do prazo impedirá a participação no processo de atribuição inicial de classes e aulas 2025.

Para mais informações, acesse o Diário Oficial do Estado de São Paulo.

description:

Novidades

Com duração de um ano, o programa oferece oportunidades para recém-formados, com job rotation entre os negócios e desenvolvimento acelerado na sede do grupo em Fortaleza (CE)

Fortaleza, novembro de 2024 — O Grupo Edson Queiroz (GEQ), uma das maiores holdings multissetoriais do Brasil, anuncia a abertura das inscrições para o seu Programa de Trainee de 2025. O GEQ busca jovens talentos com potencial de liderança, disposição para inovar e interesse por desafios.

O Programa Trainee GEQ 2025 ficará aberto para inscrições até o dia 16 de dezembro, oferecendo 32 vagas para atuar na sede do grupo, localizada em Fortaleza (CE). Com duração de 12 meses, o programa inclui job rotation entre os diferentes negócios, mentorias com profissionais da alta gestão e a elaboração de projetos estratégicos. Durante essa jornada de desenvolvimento, os trainees terão o acompanhamento contínuo da equipe de Recursos Humanos e de gestores do grupo.

As vagas estão distribuídas em diversas áreas, como:

  • Marketing, Comercial e Vendas;
  • Industrial e Manutenção;
  • Engenharia e Qualidade;
  • Comunicação e Inovação Digital;
  • Soluções Energéticas.

Para se candidatar, os interessados devem ter concluído o bacharelado ou licenciatura entre agosto de 2022 e agosto de 2024 em cursos como Administração, Engenharias, Ciências Econômicas, Ciências Contábeis, Psicologia, Pedagogia, Direito, Comunicação e Tecnologia. Além disso, é necessário possuir domínio em inglês, bons conhecimentos de informática e disponibilidade para residir em Fortaleza.

As inscrições para o Programa podem ser realizadas diretamente pela plataforma Cia de Talentos. Todas as etapas do processo serão realizadas de forma online, com exceção da etapa final, que ocorrerá presencialmente na capital cearense.

Sobre o Grupo Edson Queiroz – Desde 1951, o GEQ se faz presente nos mais diversos momentos da vida dos brasileiros por meio de um portfólio diversificado de marcas e produtos de segmentos variados. O Grupo consolidou uma cultura de pioneirismo e desenvolvimento de grandes negócios, empregando cerca de 10 mil colaboradores e guiando suas decisões nos princípios éticos que baseiam todas as suas relações.

Sobre a empresa

A TECNOFAST é uma empresa brasileira de capital fechado com sede em Novo Hamburgo, no estado do Rio Grande do Sul (RS). A empresa foi constituída há 43 anos e atua com a marca própria AIRFIX (marca registrada) e marca associada PREBENA (Alemanha) no mercado nacional brasileiro de fixadores industriais.

O negócio é a produção de grampos, pinos industriais, prego eletro-soldados e distribuição de ferramentas de fixação pneumáticas.

A marca AIRFIX é há mais de uma década reconhecida como uma das marcas mais lembradas no setor moveleiro e na cadeia da madeira.

Possuímos um parque industrial de mais de 4.000 metros quadrados (em uma área de 11.000 m2) e capacidade instalada de produção de 600 toneladas mensais. Nosso foco principal é atender as seguintes indústrias: móveis, estofados, embalagens, colchões, construção civil e estofados automotivos.

Na gestão de recursos humanos, a Tecnofast possui alta de promoção e integração de seus colaboradores: 90% dos colaboradores recomendam a Tecnofast como um local de trabalho e 92% consideram a comunicação com os colegas como excelente.

Auxiliar, pela sua experiência, os demais operadores no treinamento e resolução de problemas do dia a dia.

Comunicação oral e escrita; Colaboração; Criatividade; Resolução de problemas; Proatividade; Resiliência.

Conhecimento:

Mecânica e elétrica de máquinas; Manutenção corretiva e preventiva; Uso de formulários, planilhas e gráficos; Controle de estoques e projeção de uso.

Relacionamento interpessoal; Resolução de conflitos; Trabalho em equipe;

title: PROGRAMA VEM PRA LEO Barueri - SP Efetivo
description:
• Você busca um lugar para aprender e contribuir? Venha fazer parte do time Leo Madeiras.

A Leo Madeiras é uma das maiores distribuidoras de produtos e serviços para marcenaria do Brasil, que valoriza as pessoas e oferece oportunidades de aprendizado, independentemente de sua condição física, mental, social, idade, etnia, identidade de gênero, credo ou orientação sexual. Para nós, o mais importante é que seu perfil esteja alinhado aos nossos princípios e cultura.

Estamos em busca de um talento que gostaria de nos ajudar na nossa missão e jornada, se identificou? Venha Ser Leo!

Junte-se ao Nosso Time em Expansão!

Vagas Abertas para Diversas Oportunidades

Você está em busca de uma nova oportunidade de carreira? Quer fazer parte de uma empresa em pleno crescimento? Então, essa é a sua chance!

Estamos em fase de expansão e buscando pessoas talentosas e motivadas para integrar nosso time.

Se você é proativo, gosta de desafios e deseja crescer profissionalmente, venha fazer parte do nosso sucesso!

Oportunidades Disponíveis:

Vendedores e Atendentes:

  • Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Proatividade e dinamismo são essenciais;
  • Boa comunicação e simpatia são fundamentais.

Caixa:

  • Operação de caixa e registro de vendas;
  • Atendimento ao cliente no pagamento;
  • Conferência e fechamento de caixa;
  • Responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes são cruciais.

Auxiliar Operacional (área de Logística e CD):

  • Apoio nas operações de loja;
  • Reposição de produtos;
  • Organização do estoque;
  • Agilidade e disposição para trabalho em equipe são necessárias.

Indústria - Operador de Produção:

  • Realizar atividades de produção;
  • Atuar em diversas etapas do processo industrial, como abastecer as máquinas com a matéria-prima, separar as peças para a montagem, conferir o funcionamento das máquinas, embalar os produtos, realizar a limpeza e manutenção das instalações e atender a outras demandas de produção;
  • Auxiliar no processo de montagem, embalagem e inspeção de produtos, seguindo os procedimentos e padrões estabelecidos pela empresa.

Por Que Trabalhar Conosco?

  • Ambiente de Trabalho Positivo: Valorizamos o respeito e a colaboração.
  • Oportunidade de Crescimento: Oferecemos treinamento contínuo e chances de ascensão na carreira.
  • Benefícios Atrativos: Plano de saúde, participação por resultados, vale alimentação e outros.
  • Empresa em Expansão: Faça parte de um momento de crescimento e inovação.

Fundada em 1943, a Leo evoluiu de uma loja na Rua do Gasômetro para a maior distribuidora de produtos e serviços para marcenaria do Brasil, dispondo do maior estoque e variedade do setor, com mais de 15.000 itens ofertados.

Hoje conta com mais de 110 lojas distribuídas em diversos estados brasileiros, além de um Centro de Distribuição e sede administrativa em Barueri - SP. Todas as lojas estão localizadas em pontos estratégicos como na grande São Paulo e em cidades de projeção das regiões Sudeste, Sul, Nordeste, Norte e Centro-Oeste do Brasil e também estamos presentes no Paraguai.

A filosofia de trabalho da Leo está baseada na satisfação de seus clientes. Para tanto, procura garantir qualidade dos produtos, preços competitivos e ótimo atendimento, além de praticar uma política empresarial séria e consciente, reinvestindo os resultados no próprio negócio, buscando o crescimento sustentável e continuado e assumindo um compromisso com o meio ambiente e com a sociedade.

Nossa crença está baseada no desenvolvimento profissional de nossos clientes, na valorização das pessoas, no crescimento de nosso negócio e no respeito ao meio ambiente e à sociedade.

title: Data & AI Architect
description:
The Solutions Architect is responsible for coordinating the internal and external resources necessary to produce high-quality proposals from customer released Requests for Proposals/Quotes (RFP/Q). This position works closely with Sales Teams and Delivery Managers to conduct the Business Approval Request for viable opportunities. Once approved, this role is accountable for the development of sound proposal strategies, solutions, themes, and discriminators that will be woven into the proposal response. The internal resources typically include a sales manager, presales architect, professional services, business development, legal, as well as other technical and administrative resources. The Solutions Architect works independently to develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices, proposal schedules, and provides leadership and direction to cross-functional teams assigned to work proposal efforts. The Solutions Architect ensures that the proposal response is compliant, compelling, and completed and delivered to the customer on schedule.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities Required:

  • Lead the qualification process for complex global GLM sales opportunities supporting the Global Field Sales Rep. (20%)
  • Accountable for the quality of the proposal materials including: proposal outline, compliance matrix, proposal management plan, proposal kick-off meeting materials, presentations and writing plans. (40%)
  • Manage the project plan related to proposals ensuring deadlines are met. (15%)
  • Coordinate and lead executive management proposal reviews. (10%)
  • Synchronize the cross-functional teams to develop proposal content including scope, solution, pricing and legalese. (15%)

Other Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Additional duties as assigned.
  • Meets attendance and punctuality standards.

What We're Looking For

Experience:

  • 8 to 10 Years of relevant work experience.

Education & Certifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree with Business Field of Study preferred.
  • Bachelor's Degree with BA or Other Specialized, Advanced Technical Learning field of study required.

Working Conditions:

  • Occasional non-standard work hours or overtime as business requires.
  • On-call availability required as necessary.
  • Frequent Travel Required (25%).

Key Skills

Accountability, Business, Cloud Computing, Leadership, Outside Sales, Sales, Storage Area Network (SAN), Virtualization, VMware.

What’s In It For You?

  • Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
  • Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
  • Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It’s not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
  • Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
  • Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.

At TD SYNNEX, we’re proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you’re excited about working for our company and believe you’re a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we’re looking for!

About Us

At TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX), we’re proud to share an unwavering passion for bringing compelling technology products, services and solutions to the world.

We’re an innovative partner that helps our customers maximize the value of IT investments, demonstrate business outcomes and unlock growth opportunities.

With diverse backgrounds, expertise and experiences, our co-workers make us who we are. When we seek to understand one another and recognize the power of the individual, we demonstrate respect and dignity; we learn, evolve and unlock potential to achieve outstanding results for our customers and win together. This broad perspective is integral to our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

title: Enfermeiro Líder | Oncológico
description:
Requisitos:
• Superior em Enfermagem com COREN Ativo;
• Especialização em Oncologia completa;
• Experiência na área de Oncologia e em Gestão de Unidades Oncológicas (Nível Hospitalar – comprovada);
• Experiência na área de Transplante de Medula Óssea (Nível Hospitalar - comprovada);
• Conhecimento e manejo dos Indicadores de qualidade no Serviço Assistencial e Segurança do Paciente;
• Conhecimento e manejo sobre Protocolos e Processos Operacionais Padrão;
• Conhecimento e manejo do Excel e Power Point.

Responsabilidades:
• Liderar e gerenciar a equipe de enfermagem na unidade oncológica;
• Garantir o cumprimento dos protocolos e processos operacionais padrão;
• Prestar assistência, monitorar e garantir a qualidade e segurança do paciente oncológico hospitalizado e nos cuidados ao paciente em transplante de medula óssea;
• Preparar e apresentar relatórios e apresentações usando o Excel e/ou Power Point.

Diferenciais:
• Pós em Gestão na área de saúde ou afins.

Benefícios:
• Vale Alimentação;
• Cesta Natalidade;
• Assistência Odontológica;
• Assistência Médica;
• Almoço;
• Café da manhã;
• Assistência Funeral;
• Convênio Farmácia.

Sobre a Instituição:
Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

Job Summary

The IT Security Engineer is enthusiastic about cybersecurity, understanding the business ecosystem, and committed to implementing robust security measures and technologies. They actively engage in protecting the organization’s information assets and critical data from cyber attacks and risks, ensuring the security and integrity of digital projects, initiatives and processes.

The IT Security Engineer is responsible for implementing, managing, and monitoring security measures to protect the organization’s information systems and networks. This role involves hands-on technical work to ensure the security systems are effective and up-to-date, responding to security incidents, and maintaining the overall security posture of the organization.

Responsibilities

Design and Implementation Activities
· Develops, implements and maintains security solutions that enable the enterprise to protect its information assets and capabilities, ensuring alignment with business, technology, and threat drivers.
· Develops and executes security plans based on established security practices and frameworks.
· Creates and updates security documentation (e.g., configurations, procedures, standards) to leverage security capabilities in projects and operations.
· Collaborates with IT Infrastructure & Operations to establish and maintain baseline security configuration standards for operating systems (e.g., OS hardening), applications, networking, identity and access management (IAM), mobile devices, cloud environments, AI/ML services and cybersecurity platforms.
· Drafts and implements security procedures and standards, ensuring they are reviewed and approved by IT management.
· Monitors developments and changes in the digital business and threat environments to ensure they are adequately addressed in security plans and the implementation of security controls.
· Validates IT and OT infrastructure for security best practices and recommends changes to enhance security and reduce risks where applicable.
· Assesses security configurations and access to security infrastructure tools, including firewalls, SASE platform, Email Security Gateways, XDR, MDR, SIEM, and cloud environments.
· Conducts or facilitates threat modeling of services and applications to identify and mitigate risks associated with the service or application.
· Supports the development and implementation of IT security controls to protect the organization’s information assets.
· Reviews security technologies, tools and services, and makes recommendations to the broader IT team for their use, based on risk and operational metrics.

Collaboration
· Works with business teams to conduct security assessments of existing and prospective vendors and services, including:
o Information systems used to process critical and strategic business data.
o Web applications.
o Cloud solution providers (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
o Business process outsourcing (BPOs).
o Managed service providers (MSPs).
· Partners with IT Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) to ensure security by design in infrastructure and applications, collaborating on maintaining security platforms, applications, and controls.
· Evaluates statements of work (SOWs) for vendors and service providers to ensure that adequate security protections and controls are in place.
· Collaborates with other IT members to share best practices and insights, fostering a culture of continuous improvement in cybersecurity.
· Participates in application, operations and infrastructure projects to provide security by design advice.

Qualifications

Business-Related Skills
The IT Security Engineer should share insights with the IT team and other business units. Key skills include:

Technical planning: Interpret business, technology, and threat drivers to develop security solutions.
Communication: Translate complex security issues into business terms for colleagues, presenting analyses in person and in writing. Full professional proficiency in English is required.
Financial analysis: Evaluate security technologies, assess financial costs, quantify purchasing and licensing options, estimate labor costs, and calculate total cost of ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), or payback period.
Project management: Draft project plans and coordinate with stakeholders for security services and technology implementations.

Full-Stack IT Infrastructure Knowledge:

o Networks: Knowledge of WAN, LAN, SASE security practices.
o Backup Solutions: Experience with backup solutions, especially Veeam.
Identity and Access Management (IAM):
o Experience with Windows Active Directory and Azure Entra ID.
o Knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) solutions.
IT Service Management:
o Change Management: Understanding of processes to manage changes in IT services.
o Configuration Management: Knowledge of maintaining information about configuration items required to deliver IT services.
o Asset Management: Experience in managing IT assets to ensure they are secure.
o Incident Management: Skills in managing and resolving incidents to restore normal service operation.
